title: tooling(dispatch-gates): the STALE TREE reading keeps only the moved paths the derivation actually opened
body:
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ87iti5Co7zHGEHxwKnxJVDN)_ Fixes #26334 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` 的 STALE TREE 读数只再数派生真正打开过的文件(`derivationInputs`,从 discovery 实测:全部 workflow、跟过的 composite action、根 `package.json`、每个门禁族的脚本/import/spawn/按路径读取/包清单,加引擎自身闭包);`scripts/` 下没人读的生成记录(sdui 清单记录、ADR 锚点)移动时不再误报,安静行点名被排除的路径。 - 为什么改:ui/重构落地每次都动 `scripts/` 下的生成记录,pm-only 树因此每次都读到假 STALE TREE(卡上实测派生集 52 不变),警告被忽视就失去意义。 - 风险与回滚:只改读数的过滤,不改派生族、不改任何门禁命令;一个不该排除的输入会漏报——自检用实测集钉住闭包(清单、全部 workflow、每个门禁文件、引擎与其数据模块);回滚即 revert 本 PR 的合并提交。 - 先看:`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` 的 `derivationInputs` / `liveDerivationInputs`(排除规则与降级方向)、`baseDrift` 的 `narrowed` hunk、`driftLines` 安静分支;然后 `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` 的 base drift 段。 - 两分钟验证:在落后 `origin/main` 且只差一次 ui 落地的 pm 检出跑 `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`,预期 stderr 的 banner 是 "none of the commit(s) this tree can SEE touched … 1 path(s) under the surface moved too, none of them an input of this answer: scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json",不再出现 STALE TREE(`--tier` 不做派生,仍列原始清单并注明未收窄)。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes `DERIVATION_SURFACE` stays the pathspec roots the staleness diff is scoped to (`.github/workflows`, `.github/actions`, `package.json`, `scripts`). What is new is that the moved paths under those roots are **narrowed to the files the derivation actually opened**, measured rather than listed — the "narrowed surface" option of the two the order named, chosen because its self-test can prove the negative from the discovery itself instead of from a hand list that would rot the next time a generated record lands under `scripts/`. - `derivationInputs()` (new, exported): the measured set — every workflow file, every composite action the follow opened, the root `package.json`, and for every discovered family its gate files, first-party imports, spawned programs, program-text reads and package manifests, plus the engine's own module closure (this file, its first-party imports — the data module two levels down from every family — and the battery it loads by `import()`). Memoised per discovery, which is memoised per tree, so a derivation that already discovered pays nothing more. - `narrowToDerivationInputs(moved, inputs)` (new, exported): the pure split into `changed` (inputs) and `ignored` (under the roots, not inputs). `inputs` null keeps everything — the superset reading. - `baseDrift({ cwd, inputs })`: reads the same three-dot diff, then narrows it by the `inputs` its CALLER names — a set, or a function asked only once something moved under the roots. The reading gains an `ignored` field beside `changed` (`null` = not narrowed), and only `changed` decides loud vs quiet. The CLI's deriving modes (`--commands`, `--ran`, the human list) hand in `liveDerivationInputs`, which costs nothing extra because the derivation discovers the same tree through the same memo; `--tier` reads no workflow by contract, so it hands in nothing and its loud reading says it was not narrowed. A first draft let `baseDrift` discover on its own: a battery of `--tier` children on a stale tree then paid a ~14 s discovery each and the full self-test ran 24 minutes — so the choice moved to the caller. A discovery that throws degrades to no narrowing (over-report, never under-report). - `driftLines`: the quiet branch names what it set aside (`N path(s) under the surface moved too, none of them an input of this answer: …`, first three named), so the quiet reads as a measurement and not as the silence a level tree gets. A reading that set nothing aside renders byte-identically to before. - Derived families and gate commands: untouched — no discovery code changed; `--commands` derives the same 30 families on a51cd08e and on 4b203a9d. The card's named specimen, `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/**`, had already been retired on `main` by e931621a (2026-10-27T01:15Z, #26367) before the seat's premise check — see Acceptance notes — so the live specimens are `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` (moves on every ui landing that regenerates the manifest) and `scripts/adr-anchors/*.json` (moves on refactor landings); the fix closes the class rather than the one path. ## Tests `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test` (both tiers) on head 4b203a9d: `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2224 cases pass.` (`fast 1935 case(s) in 353.9s · slow 289 case(s) in 974.3s`). ⚠️ The base-drift section is in the SLOW tier, and CI runs only the fast tier on `pull_request` / `merge_group` (`scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs`, #22991) — so this PR's check-runs do not exercise the new temporary-repository and LIVE cases; this local two-tier run is their evidence, and the hourly `schedule` run is the first CI run that will. The full run also caught two slow-tier-only ordering bugs in the first draft of these cases (a case reading a fixture above its declaration); fixed in 9a12ebe1 and 4b203a9d, and every identifier the new cases read was then checked declared-before-read. New cases in the base-drift section, one per direction the order asked for and the live pins the measured set needs: - FRESH — temporary repository: upstream regenerates `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/core.json` under the roots; the raw reading reports it (the departure pin: what used to go loud); narrowed by the inputs the same tree reads `changed: []`, `ignored: [that record]`, and renders the quiet two-line shape naming the set-aside record, no `STALE TREE`; a foreign checkout handed no inputs is not narrowed. - STALE — same repository: a changed `scripts/check-thing.mjs` still goes loud and is named alone (`Stale here: scripts/check-thing.mjs`) with the record still set aside; a workflow (`.github/workflows/lint.yml`) and the root `package.json` moving upstream go loud, both named. - LIVE pins on this tree's measured set: every input is a tracked file; it holds the root manifest and every workflow file; this engine, its data module and its battery; every gate file of every discovered family; it is a strict subset of the tracked files under `scripts/` (265 of 442 on 4b203a9d), so the narrowing is not vacuous; `liveDerivationInputs()` answers that same set; and `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` is tracked and NOT an input. - Mode split: a level tree never asks for the inputs (a throwing function proves it is not called); inputs handed in as a function read identically to the set; an un-narrowed loud reading says `Not narrowed to what the answer is made of … A --commands or --ran run measures the inputs and lists only those.`, a narrowed one does not. - Renderings: the quiet line with set-aside paths (counted past the third), byte-identity when nothing was set aside, the pure split's order. ## Acceptance notes - **Premise, measured** (os-dev rule 6): the card's trigger directory `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/` does not exist on `main` — retired by e931621a (2026-10-27T01:15Z, "retire the per-package SDUI manifest records", #26367), after the card was filed (2026-10-26T21:5xZ) and before the seat's read-only premise check at b53322d5 (`git ls-tree b53322d5 scripts/` lists `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, `check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` and no `sdui-manifest.sources`). The mechanism the card names holds unchanged: the whole `scripts/` root was counted, and generated records under it still move on landings in other lanes — `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` at 1bbb7bf4 (ui), `scripts/adr-anchors/*.json` at b7f8a2eb, 2e7127bc (refactor) — and the derivation opens none of them (measured: 265 of 442 tracked `scripts/**` files are inputs on 4b203a9d). The card's "Wanted" is met for the class; `premise_still_valid: true` with that correction. - **Inputs outside the roots** (observation, not fixed here): the measured set holds 43 files outside `DERIVATION_SURFACE` — gate scripts resolved through package manifests (`packages/spec/scripts/check-*.ts`, `packages/lint/scripts/*.mjs`), `packages/spec/package.json`, and program-text reads such as `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`. The diff stays scoped to the roots, as the ruling's "nothing wider" asks, so an upstream change to one of those still reads as off-surface, exactly as before this PR. Widening the diff to the measured set would be the honest next step; it is a separate decision. - The `fix:` remedy in the third unmeasured door still prints the raw `git diff --name-only … -- ROOTS` command: it is the superset a reader can run by hand; the narrowing is applied on top of it and is not something a shell one-liner can reproduce. - A changed `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` upstream counts as an input (the engine closure includes the battery) — a conservative choice: it does not move the answer, but `check:pm-dispatch-gates` runs it, and over-reporting is this file's degraded direction. ## Verification Three real landings replayed on throwaway checkouts (a `--shared` clone of this worktree with `refs/remotes/origin/main` pinned at the landing and HEAD at its parent; "before" = that tree's own engine, `--tier`; "after" = this PR's engine module closure committed on top, run in a deriving mode, `--commands`):
1bbb7bf4 — a ui landing whose only movement under the roots is scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json (the card's class) Before: ``` ⚠️ STALE TREE — this answer is derived from a tree at least 1 commit(s) behind origin/main, and 1 file(s) it derives from CHANGED across that range. Stale here: scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json ``` After: ``` At least 1 commit(s) behind origin/main, and none of the commit(s) this tree can SEE touched what this answer derives from — HEAD 2026-10-26T12:40:29+00:00 vs origin/main 1bbb7bf4 2026-10-26T12:45:21+00:00. 1 path(s) under the surface moved too, none of them an input of this answer: scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json. ```
b7f8a2eb — a refactor landing whose only movement under the roots is an ADR anchor record Before: `STALE TREE … 1 file(s) it derives from CHANGED` / `Stale here: scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__engine-execute-transactions.ts.json`. After: `none of the commit(s) this tree can SEE touched what this answer derives from … 1 path(s) under the surface moved too, none of them an input of this answer: scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__engine-execute-transactions.ts.json.`
e931621a — the sentinel retirement itself: two workflows and three gate scripts moved beside 27 records (the control that must stay STALE) Before: `STALE TREE … 32 file(s) it derives from CHANGED` / `Stale here: .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/lint.yml scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json … +26 more`. After: `STALE TREE … 5 file(s) it derives from CHANGED` / `Stale here: .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/lint.yml scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` — the verdict for a real derivation-input change is unchanged; only the records left the list.
The `--ran` reconciliation on this branch, head 4b203a9d (no drift line: the tree was level with the fetched `origin/main` when it ran):
Derived gates — 30 families, run locally on 4b203a9d, reconciled with --ran ``` node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-declaration-mirrors.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-declaration-mirrors.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/check-whole-set-label-write.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-whole-set-label-write.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 pnpm check:agent-test-spelling :: exit 0 pnpm check:bash32-floor :: exit 0 pnpm check:ci-filter-parity :: exit 0 pnpm check:cli-command-ids :: exit 0 pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs :: exit 0 pnpm check:declared-population-live :: exit 0 pnpm check:driver-memory-census :: exit 0 pnpm check:entry-guard :: exit 0 pnpm check:gitlink-declared :: exit 0 pnpm check:nul-bytes :: exit 0 pnpm check:parse-guard :: exit 0 pnpm check:pnpm-filter-targets :: exit 0 pnpm check:pnpm-flag-spellings :: exit 0 pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority :: exit 0 pnpm check:refd-timer-probe :: exit 0 pnpm check:scripts-symbol-anchors :: exit 0 pnpm check:watch-hint-literal :: exit 0 pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates :: exit 0 Run reconciliation — 30 derived, 30 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. ✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 30 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 30 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 30 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3). ```
`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is not in this card's derived list. `--tier` on each throwaway tree now prints the raw list plus the not-narrowed line (e.g. 32 files on e931621a), by design. No package is touched (no ① closure, no ② package suite); `pnpm lint` as a repo-wide sweep is CI's run — `eslint scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` exits 0 locally. ## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (n/a — no schema touched) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the two files, exit 0; the repo sweep is CI's) - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (`scripts/pm/**` publishes nothing — `skip-changeset`) - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (n/a) - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01JQwxbZ5vD35MzQ8UqhhTJB
